card.name: Words leading into pre-existing conditions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, of, had or have right after patients or a toxicity statement, where the next words name a prior or underlying condition or risk factor. Also the start of preexisting.

modes.label: with after patients
modes.description: The word with after patients, introducing a prior history or underlying disease in a warning about organ toxicity.
modes.example: These adverse reactions may be more common in patients<< with>> a prior history of coronary artery disease.

modes.label: of or have before baseline illness
modes.description: Of or have or had leading into underlying or other health problems or risk factors.
modes.example: Renal failure may arise from exacerbation<< of>> underlying baseline hepatic impairment or severe dehydration

modes.label: Start of preexisting
modes.description: The opening piece of the word preexisting.
modes.example: concomitant medications and/or<< pre>>existing disease, and the relationship to fing

card.writes: It promotes words like underlying, existing and pre, pushing the text toward naming a pre-existing condition.
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before a warning names a patient's prior or underlying illness.
